sites.name: Sly Creek
sites.feeText: $ 20 a site. $ 2 dollar for extra car. Overflow parking available.
sites.restrictions: 14 day maximum stay OHV use prohibited in campground area.

sites.name: Strawberry
sites.restrictions: 14 day maximum stay. OHV use prohibited in campground area.
sites.reservations: Reservations are not accepted at this facility

sites.name: Golden Trout Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $15 per night
sites.about: This campground has 15 first come sites. One of the sites is accessible and some sites can accommodate large groups. Campground amenities include water and vault toilets. Campsite amenities include picnic tables and fire ring. Stream fishing, day hiking, nature viewing and OHV riding are some of…
sites.restrictions: 14 day limit. 6 people per campsite and. 2 vehicles per campsite. 14 day camping limit, . OHV riding is not allowed in the campground, . Bear Awareness
sites.reservations: This campground does not allow reservations.
sites.accessibility: all units have accessible features, one unit is fully accessible.

sites.name: Carlton Flat Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $24 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Carlton Flat Campground is located on the North Yuba River along Hwy 49. There are 17 campsites with vault toilets and piped water. There is access to the North Yuba Trail. Campground is surrounded by pine and oak trees.
sites.directions: From Camptonville: Drive 9 miles northeast on Hwy 49. Campground is on North Yuba River.
sites.reservations: This site can be reserved by calling Toll Free 1-877-444-6777 (International 518-885-3639 or TDD 877-833-6777), or on-line at Recreation.gov

sites.name: Cal Ida Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $24 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Cal-Ida Campground is located on the North Yuba River along Hwy 49. Campground is surrounded by oak, maple and locust trees. Access to the North Yuba Trail.
sites.directions: From Camptonville: Drive 9 miles on Hwy 49. Take Cal-Ida Road where it joins 49.
sites.restrictions: Camping outside designated campground is prohibited in this area
sites.reservations: This site can be reserved by calling Toll Free 1-877-444-6777 (International 518-885-3639 or TDD 877-833-6777), or on-line at Recreation.gov

sites.name: Fiddle Creek Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $24 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Fiddle Creek Campground is located on the north bank of the North Yuba River along Hwy. 49. There are 15 campsites-tent camping only-with vault toilets and piped water. It is surrounded by oak, maple, locust, and pine trees. Access to the North Yuba Trail.
sites.directions: From Camptonville: Drive 9 miles northeast on Hwy 49. Campground is on North Yuba River.
sites.restrictions: Camping outside designated campground is prohibited in this area
sites.reservations: This site can be reserved by calling Toll Free 1-877-444-6777 (International 518-885-3639 or TDD 877-833-6777), or on-line at Recreation.gov
sites.accessibility: Campsites, restroom and trail to river overlook.

sites.name: Indian Valley Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $24 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Indian Valley Campground is located on the north bank of the North Yuba River along Hwy 49 about 15 miles north of Camptonville. There are 19 campsites with vault toilets and piped water. It is surrounded by oak, fir, pine, and madrone trees. Access to the North Yuba Trail.
sites.directions: From Camptonville: Drive 10 miles northeast on Hwy 49. Campground is on North Yuba River.
sites.reservations: This site can be reserved by calling Toll Free 1-877-444-6777 (International 518-885-3639 or TDD 877-833-6777), or on-line at Recreation.gov
sites.accessibility: Parking, restrooms, selected campsites, raised tent pad, river overlook.

sites.name: Rocky Rest Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $24 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from faucets
sites.about: Rocky Rest Campground is located ten miles northeast of Camptonville on a ridge above the North Yuba River along Hwy 49. There are 10 campsites, piped water and vault toilets. The North Yuba Trailhead is near the campground. There is a scenic bridge across the Yuba River. Access to a rocky beach…
sites.directions: From Camptonville: Drive 10 miles northeast on Hwy 49. Campground is located on the North Yuba River.
sites.reservations: This site can be reserved by calling Toll Free 1-877-444-6777 (International 518-885-3639 or TDD 877-833-6777), or on-line at Recreation.gov

sites.name: Madrone Cove
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $24 per night
sites.hours: Check in: 2:00 p.m.; Check-out: 12:00 p.m.; Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.waterText: Water can be treated or filtered from nearby water sources
sites.directions: From Camptonville: Drive south on Hwy 49 to Marysville Road and turn right. Continue 5 miles. Campground is 5 miles north west of Dark Day Boat Ramp on west shore of Bullards Bar Reservoir.…
sites.reservations: This site can be reserved by calling Toll Free 1-877-444-6777 (International 518-885-3639 or TDD 877-833-6777), or on-line at Recreation.gov

sites.name: Frenchy Point
sites.hours: Day use only: open 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.
sites.waterText: Water can be treated or filtered from nearby water sources
sites.directions: Located 5 miles northwest of Dark Day Boat Ramp on the west side of the reservoir.
